stage: Role Lens v0: prove one material across multiple learner actions before broader architecture

phase.engine: through Phase 2D plus merged Phrase Foundation PR 1
phase.runtime: merged Harmonic Gravity Product Spine v1 plus active bounded Role Lens v0 slice
phase.learningValidation: four legacy Lab experiences plus Product Spine v1 physically/browser validated and accepted

activeWork.summary: Role Lens v0 is commissioned to prove that one supplied musical material can support at least two genuinely different learner actions without a universal recipe/context framework.

gate.statement: Role Lens v0 must reuse current deterministic facts first and prove multiple genuinely different learner actions over the same supplied material. No universal Exercise Recipe JSON/DSL, permanent Context layer, broad engine expansion, Audio, Style runtime or AI is included. Require exact-head verify, exact-head Pages preview, Arun browser/physical-guitar review and explicit approval before merge.

deferred: Phrase/Harmony PR 2 unless a concrete learner task needs its facts and it is separately commissioned
generic voicing or voice-leading engine promotion
general Experience Router or Practice/Learning Engine infrastructure
universal Exercise Recipe JSON/DSL or permanent generic Context/Constraint layer
Audio Out until Role Lens evidence justifies a concrete learner need
Audio In beyond a later uncertainty-preserving Tier 0-2 feasibility spike
microphone grading, polyphonic/style grading or AI audio judgment
Style Pack runtime/generator; first run only a 5-10 fragment representation pressure study
meter/groove/articulation/polyphony/timed-harmony expansion until repeated real material requires one specific addition
AI tutor/runtime until stable material/action boundaries and a demonstrated learner benefit exist
production deployment or paid/external preview infrastructure
GX-10/rig control and broad AI-agent integration
curriculum graphs and large random-content generators
